## My account

Sign in or create account

Boston Scientific accounts are for healthcare professionals only.

Create an account to access online training and education on EDUCARE, manage your customer profile,
and connect with customer support and service teams.

My Boston Scientific account

Access your online applications and manage your customer profile.

Patients and innovation

These treatments destroy tumors, lessen side effects and reduce pain.

At Boston Scientific, every employee plays a role in transforming lives.

[See how we create a culture of quality][159]

Our award-winning career development program teaches skills for work – and life.

[Meet two graduates][160]

Company news

[View the results here][161]

At Boston Scientific, we are driven to help patients experience more – more dancing, more playing,
more celebrating, more living.

## Explore Boston Scientific

[Smiling Boston Scientific employees at conference table.]

Careers

### Grow your career at Boston Scientific

Come help us transform lives by working at the forefront of medical innovation.

[Search for jobs][162]

improve the health of patients around the world.

## The History of Henry Schein

[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

Strengthening Healthcare

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

Home

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

Healthcare Professionals

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]
Previous Next
1. Slide 1

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]
[------------------]

Careers

 

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

## We are Roche

We combine life-changing diagnostics and medicines to take on the toughest healthcare challenges,
those that place the greatest strain on patients, families, communities, and health systems. 

Guided by the experiences of patients, we are determined to prevent, stop and cure diseases so
people can live healthier, longer lives.

for stent evaluation.

[article cover]

[¹⁸F]FDG PET.

copayment amounts.

[article cover]

radiopharmaceuticals.

#### [Vision Language Models for Axillary Lymph Nodes][83]

This study evaluated the performance of vision-language models with image-only diagnostic input for
detecting malignancy in biopsied axillary lymph nodes in patients with breast cancer.
Peng He ... Fang-Meng Fu
[article cover]

#### [Super-Resolution DLR for Coronary Stents on CTA][84]

The novel super-resolution deep-learning reconstruction algorithm improves the performance of
coronary CTA obtained on conventional 320-row MDCT scanners and could support expanded use of CTA
for stent evaluation.
Cheng Xu ... Yining Wang
[article cover]

#### [Diabetes Medications and FDG PET Preparation][85]

This *AJR* Expert Panel Narrative Review examines the effects of hyperglycemia and insulin exposure
on [¹⁸F]FDG biodistribution and proposes preparation strategies for patients undergoing oncologic
[¹⁸F]FDG PET.
Philipose G. Mulugeta ... Margo Hudson
[article cover]

#### [Patient Cost-Sharing in Medicare Advantage Plans][86]

Patient cost-sharing for outpatient advanced diagnostic imaging varied across Medicare Advantage
plans, with the emergence of a small percentage of plans having outlier high coinsurance rates or
copayment amounts.
Jessica I. Billig ... Joshua M. Liao
[article cover]

#### [PSMA PET Radiopharmaceuticals][87]

This Special Series Review takes an evidence-based approach to provide insights into clinically
relevant similarities and differences of FDA-approved and late-stage research PSMA PET
radiopharmaceuticals.
Justin G. Peacock ... Phillip H. Kuo
[article cover]

## We Work for Your Health!

**Nişantaşı Centermed Private Radiology Center** is our first institution with 23 years of
experience in advanced radiodiagnostic diagnosis. As the **Centermed Academy, Centermed Plus**, and
**Betemar** family, we are at your service in **radiodiagnostic and interventional radiology fields
with our competent physicians, technicians, nurses, and all team members, using the most up-to-date
advanced technology devices** for our valued physicians and patients.

We add value to your health with advanced technology.
Always by your side, we lead in healthcare.

Call Us 444 2 211
][22]

## Our Services
* [ [Service] Service][23]
* [ [Body Area] Body Area][24]
* [ [Specialties] Specialties][25]
* [
  Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) (3TESLA)
  
  Magnetic Resonance Imaging is a painless, non-invasive, cross-sectional medical imaging method
  that provides high-resolution imaging of the body using a strong magnetic field (magnet), radio
  waves, and advanced computers with specialized software.
  
  ][26][Service Detail ][27]
* [
  Computed Tomography (CT)
  
  A computed tomography examination is a non-invasive, fast, painless, safe radiological method that
  obtains sectional or tomographic images from X-ray (radiograph) images taken from different angles
  of our body using advanced computers and software.
  
  ][28][Service Detail ][29]
* [
  Ultrasonography (USG)
  
  Ultrasound (USG, Ultrasonography, Sonography) is a non-invasive medical imaging method that uses
  sound waves to obtain images called sonograms. Unlike direct radiographs (X-ray), there is no
  radiation exposure in this method.
  
  ][30][Service Detail ][31]
* [
  Hysterosalpingography
  
  Hysterosalpingography is an X-ray imaging method aimed at detecting difficulties in becoming
  pregnant (infertility), recurrent miscarriages, and anomalies in the anatomy of the reproductive
  system in women.
  
  ][32][Service Detail ][33]
* [
  Fluoroscopy
  
  Although digital radiography or X-ray and fluoroscopy have some differences, they use the same
  technology. While X-ray obtains static images, fluoroscopy is an imaging method obtaining
  real-time live videos of body structures using X-ray.
  
  ][34][Service Detail ][35]
* [
  Panoramic X-Ray
  
  Panoramic X-Ray requested by dentists before examination; it is a radiological examination that
  captures the entire mouth in a single image, including teeth, upper and lower jaws, surrounding
  structures, and tissues.
  
  ][36][Service Detail ][37]
* [
  Cephalometric X-Ray
  
  Cephalometric X-ray is the imaging of the facial region from the side (profile). It is used to
  evaluate the bones, teeth, jaw joint, and soft tissues in this area.
  
  ][38][Service Detail ][39]
* [
  Bone Density Measurement (DEXA)
  
  Bone density measurement is used to diagnose osteoporosis, osteopenia, and other issues related to
  bone density.
  
  ][40][Service Detail ][41]

[
Call Us 444 2 211
][22]

## Our Services
* [ [Service] Service][23]
* [ [Body Area] Body Area][24]
* [ [Specialties] Specialties][25]
* [
  Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) (3TESLA)
  
  Magnetic Resonance Imaging is a painless, non-invasive, cross-sectional medical imaging method
  that provides high-resolution imaging of the body using a strong magnetic field (magnet), radio
  waves, and advanced computers with specialized software.
  
  ][26][Service Detail ][27]
* [
  Computed Tomography (CT)
  
  A computed tomography examination is a non-invasive, fast, painless, safe radiological method that
  obtains sectional or tomographic images from X-ray (radiograph) images taken from different angles
  of our body using advanced computers and software.
  
  ][28][Service Detail ][29]
* [
  Ultrasonography (USG)
  
  Ultrasound (USG, Ultrasonography, Sonography) is a non-invasive medical imaging method that uses
  sound waves to obtain images called sonograms. Unlike direct radiographs (X-ray), there is no
  radiation exposure in this method.
  
  ][30][Service Detail ][31]
* [
  Hysterosalpingography
  
  Hysterosalpingography is an X-ray imaging method aimed at detecting difficulties in becoming
  pregnant (infertility), recurrent miscarriages, and anomalies in the anatomy of the reproductive
  system in women.
  
  ][32][Service Detail ][33]
* [
  Fluoroscopy
  
  Although digital radiography or X-ray and fluoroscopy have some differences, they use the same
  technology. While X-ray obtains static images, fluoroscopy is an imaging method obtaining
  real-time live videos of body structures using X-ray.
  
  ][34][Service Detail ][35]
* [
  Panoramic X-Ray
  
  Panoramic X-Ray requested by dentists before examination; it is a radiological examination that
  captures the entire mouth in a single image, including teeth, upper and lower jaws, surrounding
  structures, and tissues.
  
  ][36][Service Detail ][37]
* [
  Cephalometric X-Ray
  
  Cephalometric X-ray is the imaging of the facial region from the side (profile). It is used to
  evaluate the bones, teeth, jaw joint, and soft tissues in this area.
  
  ][38][Service Detail ][39]
* [
  Bone Density Measurement (DEXA)
  
  Bone density measurement is used to diagnose osteoporosis, osteopenia, and other issues related to
  bone density.
  
  ][40][Service Detail ][41]
* [
  Fully Equipped Laboratory
  
  All detailed blood and urine tests, culture examinations can be performed. By providing
  laboratory-clinical-radiology correlation, simple or detailed check-up (control-screening)
  programs can be applied.
  
  ][42][Service Detail ][43]
* [
  Interventional Radiology
  
  Interventional radiology is a medical subspecialty that performs the diagnosis and treatment of
  diseases using medical imaging techniques.
  
  ][44][Service Detail ][45]
* [
  Brain and Spine Imaging
  
  Imaging of head, brain, neck, and spinal injuries and pathologies using the most advanced imaging
  technologies. MRI and CT are the primary technologies utilized in this area.
  
  ][46][Service Detail ][47]
* [
  Cardiac and Circulatory System Imaging
  
  Cardiovascular and circulatory system diseases, the leading cause of death worldwide, are critical
  for early diagnosis.
  
  ][48][Service Detail ][49]
* [
  Lung and Surrounding Tissues Imaging
  
  Performed for screening, diagnosis, and interventional procedures in diseases of the lungs and
  surrounding organs and tissues.
  
  ][50][Service Detail ][51]
* [
  Abdominal (Belly) Imaging
  
  Abdominal and pelvic imaging involves the evaluation of the liver, gallbladder, bile ducts,
  spleen, pancreas, kidneys, adrenal glands, small and large intestines, aorta, inferior vena
  cava...
  
  ][52][Service Detail ][53]
* [
  Skeletal and Muscular System Imaging
  
  Bones, joints, muscles, ligaments, tendons, the spine, and muscles are evaluated in detail for
  systemic diseases, traumas, cancers, arthritis, and arthrosis-related conditions.
  
  ][54][Service Detail ][55]
* [
  Breast Imaging
  
  Breast cancer is the second most common cancer worldwide after lung cancer. Early detection
  significantly increases survival rates.
  
  ][56][Service Detail ][57]
* [
  Prostate Imaging
  
  Early diagnosis of prostate cancer is important in improving treatment and survival rates.
  
  ][58][Service Detail ][59]
* [
  Specialized Procedures
  
  Specialized procedures encompass the diagnosis of pathologies, evaluation of organ functions,
  biopsies, and interventional procedures using one or more methods.
  
  ][60][Service Detail ][61]

## About Data Insights Market

Data Insights Market is one of the leading providers of syndicated and customized research reports,
consulting services, and analytical information on markets and companies across the world. Data
Insights Market partners with clients in many countries and industry verticals such as A & D,
Chemical & material, Energy Power, F & B, Retail, Healthcare and many more to provide high value
market research reports and consulting services. Our skilled analysts work towards understanding the
specific needs of each client to produce relevant insights that most suit his individual needs.
Since its inception, Data Insights Market has continued to innovate, increased its product and
service portfolio, and remained focused on the needs of its clients to root out poor-quality data
and establish itself as a winning partner for businesses. DIM has a legacy of serving and
facilitating clients from all over the world and played a vital role in their success story. Our
clients include many types of organizations, the majority of which are Fortune 500 companies.

The 360-degree research methodology requires us to only dispense facilities based on our unique data
model so that the authenticity and integrity of the services are maintained. This methodology makes
sure that the analysis is comprehensive and accurate. We can provide services of importance to our
clients well within the time limit by keeping a close eye on relevant press releases, official
publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the
following: We use a variety of new, useful approaches to big data and the tools of qualitative and
quantitative marketing research to understand clients properly. The key objectives are to examine
niche markets, outline the main drivers, and indicate the most hazardous obstacles. We track major
local and global trends in this field and strive to balance the quality level within a given time
period while meeting the specialized and specialty needs of the industry.

Founded in 2002, Dragon Crown Medical Co., Ltd. is a hi-tech enterprise integrating R&D, manufacture
and sales of medical products. 
From the first beginning, Dragon Crown has always focused on providing MISS overall solutions in
spine and joint surgery fields. Based on its strong R & D capability and innovative spirit, Dragon
Crown is equipped with more than 100 domestic and international patents, and has created a whole
industrial chain layout of design, R & D, production and sales.

orthopaedic instruments and equipment, mainly including bone filling container, balloon catheter, 
remote controlled injection manipulator, expandable retractor, V-shaped multi-channel spinal
instruments, medical endoscope, camera system with matched instruments, orthopaedic shaver system
and accessories etc..  The market competitiveness of products has always been at the leading level

13485:2016, Vertebral Forming Unitized Surgical Instruments & Vertebroplasty Toolkit, Expandable
Retractor System, Bone Filling Container, and Remote Controlled Injection Manipulator, have already

  complications, including abdominal catastrophes.

  beverages.
  November 13, 2025

  medical emergency? Are you prepared?
  Medscape Features Slideshows, November 3, 2025

  substance-abuse condition that affects every organ system.
  October 28, 2025

# See what your competitors

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data

The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.

  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

# About Our Company

## Pioneering the Future of Rail Transport

We are a world-class train manufacturing company dedicated to engineering locomotives, passenger
coaches, and freight rolling stock that set new standards in performance, safety, and
sustainability. With decades of experience in the rail industry, our state-of-the-art production
facilities combine cutting-edge robotics with time-honored craftsmanship.

Our engineering teams design high-speed trains, electric multiple units, and heavy-haul freight
locomotives that serve railway networks across six continents. Every vehicle that leaves our
assembly line undergoes rigorous testing protocols, ensuring compliance with the most demanding
international rail safety standards.

From concept design to final delivery, we partner with national rail operators and urban transit
authorities to build reliable, energy-efficient, and passenger-focused rolling stock that shapes the
future of mobility.

[A massive modern train manufacturing facility interior showing a high-speed train locomotive being
assembled on a production line with industrial robotic arms welding steel and sparks flying under
dramatic blue and orange industrial lighting]

## Our Services

⚙

### Locomotive Engineering & Assembly

We design and manufacture diesel-electric and fully electric locomotives built for endurance. Our
vertical integration approach covers everything from bogie fabrication and traction motor
installation to complete cab outfitting, delivering turnkey solutions to rail operators worldwide.

[A sleek modern high-speed bullet train on railway tracks at sunset with dramatic golden hour
lighting featuring aerodynamic silver and blue design and motion blur on background showing speed]
🚂

### Passenger Coach Manufacturing

Our passenger coaches blend ergonomic interior design with structural integrity. We produce
single-deck, double-deck, and articulated trainsets with advanced HVAC, real-time passenger
information systems, and modular seating configurations that maximize comfort and capacity.

🔧

### Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul

Beyond manufacturing, we operate full-service MRO depots that extend fleet lifespan and reduce total
cost of ownership. Our predictive maintenance platforms leverage IoT sensor data and machine
learning to schedule interventions before faults occur, keeping your fleet running at peak
efficiency.

[Close-up of precision engineering components for train manufacturing including steel wheels bogies
and suspension systems being machined in a factory with CNC machines and precision tools visible]

# Human Body Parts: Complete Guide on Organs, Systems & Labeled Diagrams

[Detailed human anatomy diagram showing major human body parts with names and functions, including
skeletal, muscular, and organ systems.]

## Overview of Human Body Parts

The human body is a masterpiece of biological engineering — built from 206 bones, approximately 650
skeletal muscles, around 78 organs, and an intricate network of blood vessels stretching over 60,000
miles. At the heart of this architecture lies an extraordinary collaboration of trillions of
specialized cells, each carrying out precise functions that collectively sustain life.

Understanding this remarkable system requires two foundational disciplines. **Anatomy** reveals the
body’s physical structure — mapping its architecture from the microscopic organization of cells and
tissues to the macroscopic arrangement of organs and interconnected systems. **Physiology**, its
inseparable counterpart, explains how those structures function — uncovering the mechanisms that
keep the body alive, balanced, and responsive.

By studying human body parts in detail, we gain far more than a map of the body’s interior. We
develop an understanding of how its diverse components are arranged, how they relate to one another,
and why that organization is essential to health, function, and survival.

## Major Structural Components of the Human Body

### The Skeletal System: 206 Bones

The adult human skeleton comprises **206 bones**, providing mechanical support, protecting vital
organs, enabling movement, storing minerals (primarily calcium and phosphorus), and housing the bone
marrow responsible for blood cell production. Bones are categorized as long, short, flat, irregular,
and sesamoid, each serving distinct anatomical purposes.

### The Muscular System: ~650 Muscles

The human body contains approximately **650 skeletal muscles**, which work in concert with the
skeletal system to produce movement, maintain posture, and generate body heat. Beyond skeletal
muscle, the body also relies on **smooth muscle** (found in the walls of hollow organs) and
**cardiac muscle** (exclusive to the heart) for involuntary and vital functions.

### The Vascular Network: Over 60,000 Miles of Blood Vessels

The circulatory system is an extraordinary anatomical achievement. A vast network of **arteries,
veins, and capillaries** — totaling over 60,000 miles in length — delivers oxygenated blood,
nutrients, hormones, and immune cells to every tissue in the body while removing metabolic waste
products. The heart pumps approximately **5 liters of blood per minute** at rest, adapting output
dynamically based on physiological demand.

### Organs: ~78 Vital Structures

Current anatomical consensus recognizes approximately **78 organs** in the human body, though
definitions vary depending on classification criteria. These range from well-known structures like
the brain, heart, and liver to lesser-discussed organs such as the mesentery, pineal gland, and
thymus. Each organ performs specialized roles essential to homeostasis and overall health.

# Human Body Parts: Complete Guide on Organs, Systems & Labeled Diagrams

[Detailed human anatomy diagram showing major human body parts with names and functions, including
skeletal, muscular, and organ systems.]

## Overview of Human Body Parts

The human body is a masterpiece of biological engineering — built from 206 bones, approximately 650
skeletal muscles, around 78 organs, and an intricate network of blood vessels stretching over 60,000
miles. At the heart of this architecture lies an extraordinary collaboration of trillions of
specialized cells, each carrying out precise functions that collectively sustain life.

Understanding this remarkable system requires two foundational disciplines. **Anatomy** reveals the
body’s physical structure — mapping its architecture from the microscopic organization of cells and
tissues to the macroscopic arrangement of organs and interconnected systems. **Physiology**, its
inseparable counterpart, explains how those structures function — uncovering the mechanisms that
keep the body alive, balanced, and responsive.

By studying human body parts in detail, we gain far more than a map of the body’s interior. We
develop an understanding of how its diverse components are arranged, how they relate to one another,
and why that organization is essential to health, function, and survival.

## Major Structural Components of the Human Body

### The Skeletal System: 206 Bones

The adult human skeleton comprises **206 bones**, providing mechanical support, protecting vital
organs, enabling movement, storing minerals (primarily calcium and phosphorus), and housing the bone
marrow responsible for blood cell production. Bones are categorized as long, short, flat, irregular,
and sesamoid, each serving distinct anatomical purposes.

### The Muscular System: ~650 Muscles

The human body contains approximately **650 skeletal muscles**, which work in concert with the
skeletal system to produce movement, maintain posture, and generate body heat. Beyond skeletal
muscle, the body also relies on **smooth muscle** (found in the walls of hollow organs) and
**cardiac muscle** (exclusive to the heart) for involuntary and vital functions.

### The Vascular Network: Over 60,000 Miles of Blood Vessels

The circulatory system is an extraordinary anatomical achievement. A vast network of **arteries,
veins, and capillaries** — totaling over 60,000 miles in length — delivers oxygenated blood,
nutrients, hormones, and immune cells to every tissue in the body while removing metabolic waste
products. The heart pumps approximately **5 liters of blood per minute** at rest, adapting output
dynamically based on physiological demand.

### Organs: ~78 Vital Structures

Current anatomical consensus recognizes approximately **78 organs** in the human body, though
definitions vary depending on classification criteria. These range from well-known structures like
the brain, heart, and liver to lesser-discussed organs such as the mesentery, pineal gland, and
thymus. Each organ performs specialized roles essential to homeostasis and overall health.

## FAQs for a Biological Dentist

###### Know the right questions to ask about root canals, mercury amalgam, and more.

May I talk with you about my dental health situation over the phone or visit your office before
making an appointment?

The response to this question can tell you if the dentist will take the time to listen and consider
your individual needs and concerns. Don’t be surprised, though, if the office doesn’t quote an exact
time or cost for any particular procedure at this time. Every case is unique, and the factors that
make it so remain unknowns until after your initial exam and appropriate diagnostic work is done.

What may I expect during an initial exam and consultation?

Any initial appointment is a kind of fact-finding mission. The dentist and staff conduct a variety
of evaluations that are appropriate to your health situation, including a traditional oral health
exam and x-rays. Newer x-rays are digital and expose you to less radiation than conventional film
x-rays. Other testing may include galvanic readings, oral cancer screening, checking the bite,
EAV/energetic testing, and diagnostic blocks.

Not all dentists rely on all of these other tests or may refer some of them out. No two doctors
practice exactly alike. This does not always mean that the care you receive from one will be
superior or inferior to that from another, just different.

Consultation time may happen at a different time. Your case might require the dentist to review and
analyze the findings in detail so they can create a specific treatment plan for you. It will include
discussion of risks and benefits, financial costs and treatment timeline – information you need to
make an informed decision about which, if any, treatment to pursue.

Do you require a comprehensive medical and dental history?

A comprehensive medical and dental history provides a dentist with insights to possible concerns. It
also helps you begin to see you own path and the relationship between various medical and dental
events. For instance, there is growing evidence that patients with a history of bisphosphonate use –
the active ingredient in osteoporosis drugs such as Fosamax, Boniva and Reclast – may develop weaker
bones, contributing to “rare but serious adverse events,” including unusual fractures, esophageal
cancer and osteonecrosis of the jaw, a painful crumbling of the jaw bone.

What kind of material compatibility testing do you use?

Compatibility testing matters, for no dental material is ”the best” for every person. The human body
is dynamic, changing over time. Any product that’s not part of the body is recognized as foreign and
may cause a reaction. The goal, then, is to determine which materials are least reactive for each
individual. This is especially important for patients with chemical sensitivities and allergies. The
most common techniques used for testing are serum (blood) compatibility, Meridian Stress Assessment
(electro-dermal screening or EAV) and Applied Kineseology.

What is your position on mercury amalgam? Is this a mercury-free practice? Is it mercury-safe, as
well? How long has the dentist practiced in a mercury free environment?

“Mercury-free” means that the office does not place new amalgam fillings. “Mercury-safe” means they
follow a strict protocol to protect patients, staff, and the environment.

If a dentist is knowledgeable and understands mercury biochemistry, it is likely they will take the
removal process seriously. What you don’t want to hear is something like, “I don’t think the mercury
in fillings is a big deal, but I’ll take them out if you like.” That dentist probably isn’t too
concerned with removal protocols and the safe handling of mercury. If the dentist provides the
equipment, skill and techniques to protect his patients, staff and self, then the same commitment is
generally practiced regarding appropriate disposal of mercury and toxic products into our
environment.

bones, contributing to “rare but serious adverse events,” including unusual fractures, esophageal
cancer and osteonecrosis of the jaw, a painful crumbling of the jaw bone.

What kind of material compatibility testing do you use?

Compatibility testing matters, for no dental material is ”the best” for every person. The human body
is dynamic, changing over time. Any product that’s not part of the body is recognized as foreign and
may cause a reaction. The goal, then, is to determine which materials are least reactive for each
individual. This is especially important for patients with chemical sensitivities and allergies. The
most common techniques used for testing are serum (blood) compatibility, Meridian Stress Assessment
(electro-dermal screening or EAV) and Applied Kineseology.

What is your position on mercury amalgam? Is this a mercury-free practice? Is it mercury-safe, as
well? How long has the dentist practiced in a mercury free environment?

“Mercury-free” means that the office does not place new amalgam fillings. “Mercury-safe” means they
follow a strict protocol to protect patients, staff, and the environment.

If a dentist is knowledgeable and understands mercury biochemistry, it is likely they will take the
removal process seriously. What you don’t want to hear is something like, “I don’t think the mercury
in fillings is a big deal, but I’ll take them out if you like.” That dentist probably isn’t too
concerned with removal protocols and the safe handling of mercury. If the dentist provides the
equipment, skill and techniques to protect his patients, staff and self, then the same commitment is
generally practiced regarding appropriate disposal of mercury and toxic products into our
environment.

# Disposable Blunt Probe

### Anatomical Palpation and Registration For Image Guided Surgery

The Disposable Passive Blunt Probe is intended to be used for anatomic palpation and registration in
[Image Guided Surgeries][84] with the Medtronic^{®} StealthStation^{®} System.

The new IZI Disposable Passive Blunt Probe offers a greatly improved standard of care and accuracy
when compared to the reusable probe. This is achieved through our consistent calibration and the
benefit of a brand new instrument for every patient.

This sterile device is designed for disposable single use and includes pre-mounted Navigation
Markers for unmatched accuracy and precise positioning every time. Wear and tear caused by repeated
sterilization and typical use is eliminated.

[LEARN MORE ][85]

[Disposable Blunt Probe]

# Welcome to Instrumed Surgical®

Instrumed Surgical® is a privately held Canadian company focusing on the endoscopy and surgical
segments of the Canadian and US medical market. We have been in business since 1987 and enjoy a
reputation of providing excellent products and customer service.

Instrumed Surgical® maintains a Medical Device Establishment Licence issued by Health Canada.

We have representatives covering all major cities in Canada from coast to coast.

Our goal is to continue to provide high-quality innovative products and services that are valued by
our customers while keeping the values of our business and customers as the most important factor.

**Health Canada’s Seal of Medical Device Excellence**

In the world of healthcare, ensuring patient safety is paramount. Enter the Medical Device
Establishment License (MDEL) from Health Canada. This crucial license serves as a quality guarantee
for companies involved in manufacturing, importing, or distributing medical devices in Canada. It
signifies rigorous scrutiny of safety measures, quality control, and adherence to international
standards. For businesses, it opens doors to Canada’s healthcare market, built on trust and
reliability. In just a few words, MDEL is the mark of excellence, assuring Canadians that their
health and well-being remain a top priority in the world of medical devices.

**Allow Instrumed Surgical To Assist in MDSAP Approval
**
Instrumed Surgical, a leading Canadian surgical distributor and manufacturer, offers expert
assistance to companies seeking certification in the medical device industry. Through the Medical
Device Single Audit Program (MDSAP), Instrumed Surgical empowers manufacturers to undergo a
comprehensive and unified assessment process. This program ensures compliance with regulatory
standards across five key markets: Australia, Brazil, Canada, Japan, and the United States.
Additionally, the auditing process, conducted on behalf of MDSAP, provides added value by
incorporating assessments for CE certification and meeting ISO 13485 requirements, helping
businesses streamline their certification journey.

## Overstock Sale Surg-N-Vac Pencils

We are liquidating excess stock of our Surg-n-Vac ESU Pencil, 
for $180.00 per box ($9.00 each.) One box of extension tubes may
also be included with each order. While supplies last. Contact your sales rep or
orders@instrumedsrugical.com to access this discount.

## Knowledgeable Quality Assurance Team

Health Canada requires all medical devices be sold by a company holding a Medical Device
Establishment Licence (MDEL), and all products class 2 and above must have a medical device licence.
Licences must be applied for and held by the manufacturer of record. Instrumed Surgical® has a staff
of Regulatory professionals who can assist and advise international suppliers through the Health
Canada licensing process.

 

## Sales Representatives With a National Reach

Instrumed Surgical® has a team of experienced sales professionals calling on all major hospitals
across Canada. We attend multiple medical conferences and trade shows annually in GI and Surgery to
establish customer relationships and needs and to promote our products and suppliers (partners).

and the private healthcare sector. We select proven, clinically effective devices that are not only

# Bone Cement

## Optimal Visibility and Versatility.

### **Infused with Insite™ Tracking Beads**

For vertebroplasty and kyphoplasty procedures, Vertefix® MV is used for fixation of pathological
fractures of the vertebral body.

Vertefix® MV is medium viscosity bone cement infused with Insite™ Tracking Beads that are optimal
size for visualization, giving you enhanced control for optimal procedural outcomes.

disposable medical devices used in interventional, diagnostic and therapeutic procedures,
particularly in cardiology, radiology, oncology, critical care and endoscopy. Merit serves client

##### We used to spend countless hours searching through comps to extract somewhat reliable info.

[Emmanuel Gallet]

Emmanuel Gallet

Finance Manager at Breega

##### It's about time for investment bankers get a user-friendly public comps platform that is
##### actually made for tech. I like Multiples UI and breadth of market verticals.

[Silvio Bellini]

Silvio Bellini

Partner, Trikon Advisors

##### I like a lot the simplicity and fluidity of the Multiples platform, and the killer part is
##### really the "verticals" classification - super useful when trying to find niche tech comps.

[Victor Huberson]

Victor Huberson

Investor at Partech

01.

## Connect to Claude and other AI tools

Extract custom insights, like buyer lists or valuation sentiment, via MCP or the native AI chatbot.
Trained directly on our dataset.

[Connect to MCP][10]

Extremely useful tool. I love the sector classification, which is much more updated and relevant to
tech investors vs. other tools in the market. It saves a lot of time!

[Constanza Diaz]

Constanza Diaz

Investor at Octopus Ventures

[Connect to Claude and other AI tools]
02.

## Investment-Grade Valuation Data

You can trust the numbers. Our public comps are powered by FactSet and Morningstar, while deal data
is sourced through a proprietary investment banking research. Benchmark 50+ various metrics like
EV/NTM revenue, EV/Gross Profit, rule of 40, Bessemer's rule of X, revenue per employee, or R&D to
sales ratio.

[See more on data][11]

Extremely useful tool. I love the sector classification, which is much more updated and relevant to
tech investors vs. other tools in the market. It saves a lot of time!

[Constanza Diaz]

Constanza Diaz

Investor at Octopus Ventures

[Investment-Grade Valuation Data]
03.

## Sector Classification Built For Digital Age

We split comps into 220+ granular categories across all industry verticals, with a special emphasis
on digital ecosystems. You can filter through tech themes like vertical AI applications or IoT as
well as compare to offline sectors like airlines or logistics.

[See more on sectors][12]

Multiples is an absolute game-changer and saved me countless hours of analysis. User-friendly UI,
it's just incredibly easy to focus on metrics that matter the most.

[Adam Hajer]

Adam Hajer

Investor at Russmedia

[Sector Classification Built For Digital Age]
04.

## Automate Valuation Workflows With API

Use our white-label API to seamlessly integrate Multiples data within your existing Sheets or Excel
workflows, or build your own financial SaaS products powered by our data - significantly cheaper
(and faster!) than legacy data providers.

[See API documentation][13]

With the most comprehensive tech-first company taxonomy I've seen for public markets, Multiples.vc
allowed us to bring the data to life for the State of European Tech Report readers.

[Hanna-Stina Sonts]

Hanna-Stina Sonts

VP at Atomico

[Automate Valuation Workflows With API]

## Finding Valuation Multiples
## Doesn't Need To Be Painful

Our mission: to deliver institutional-quality valuation data through a modern UI at a fraction of
the cost of major providers.

### AI Analyst

Native AI copilot continously trained on our dataset, so you can extract custom insights in seconds.

### Consensus Estimates

Access metrics like NTM Revenue or 2027E EBITDA, powered by FactSet, harmonized by us.

### Verified Deal Data

Get M&A and VC round valuation data with over 27% more deal multiples compared to MergerMarket.

### Historical Time Series Data

Track valuation trends with 10 years of monthly historical data across all public companies.

### Connect to Claude and other AI tools

Use [MCP][14] to extract insights from our dataset without leaving Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI
tools.

### Valuations, Automated

Automate your Google Sheets and Excel valuation workflows, or build your own tools using our
[API][15].

### 1. How is cancer diagnosed?

][26]

A biopsy is the most accurate way to find out whether you have cancer. A biopsy is when a little
piece of tissue is removed and looked at under a microscope to see if there is cancer and what sort.
Imaging (ultrasound, CT, MRI, or PET scans) and blood tests are used to confirm the diagnosis and
assess the extent of disease.

The biopsy and pathology report are the cornerstone of your treatment strategy as they tell us the
precise kind and grade of your cancer. Molecular or biomarker testing may also be done on the same
sample to help guide targeted or immunotherapy approaches.

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

### 1. How is cancer diagnosed?

][26]

A biopsy is the most accurate way to find out whether you have cancer. A biopsy is when a little
piece of tissue is removed and looked at under a microscope to see if there is cancer and what sort.
Imaging (ultrasound, CT, MRI, or PET scans) and blood tests are used to confirm the diagnosis and
assess the extent of disease.

The biopsy and pathology report are the cornerstone of your treatment strategy as they tell us the
precise kind and grade of your cancer. Molecular or biomarker testing may also be done on the same
sample to help guide targeted or immunotherapy approaches.

[

### 2. Can cancer be cured?

][27]

Many cancers are treatable, especially when caught early, and many people become long-term
cancer-free survivors. The prospects for a cure depend on the type and stage of the disease and how
the condition reacts to therapy, which is why early diagnosis is so vital.

Often, a cancer can be managed for years even if it cannot be completely cured, while quality of
life is maintained. Your treatment goal can be cure, long-term control, or reduction of symptoms.
Your oncologist can tell you what to expect, so your expectations are in tune with your situation.

[

### 3. Is immunotherapy better than chemotherapy?

][28]

Not necessarily, no. Immunotherapy is particularly effective for some tumors and some patients, but
not for others, and for many malignancies, chemotherapy remains the best or only treatment.” Not
that one is newer. It depends on the type of cancer, the stage, and biomarker information.

Some cancers may respond to immunotherapy for a longer duration. Side effects vary, but it can be
considerably more expensive and only helps a subset of people. Your oncologist may do some testing,
such as checking for biomarkers such as PD-L1, to help decide who is likely to respond.

[

### 4. How long does cancer treatment take?

][29]

Very varied. Chemotherapy is usually given in rounds, over several months, every two or three weeks.
Radiation therapy is usually administered every day for several weeks. Immunotherapy may be given
for a few months up to a year or longer. The type and stage of cancer you have, and the goal of
treatment, will determine the full timeline.

Sometimes the treatment is sequential, for example, surgery and then chemotherapy, or chemo and
radiation at the same time. When you have a plan in place, your oncologist can provide you with a
schedule with expected breaks in between cycles for healing.

[

### 5. Can chemotherapy be given as day care, without admission?

][30]

Yes, many chemotherapy regimens can be given as a day case procedure, where you attend in the
morning, receive the infusion over a few hours, and go home the same evening without an overnight
stay. This is safe for most usual regimens and is determined by your oncologist. 

Day-care chemotherapy can save hospital costs considerably in comparison with admission, with the
advantage of close observation. Patients needing intensive regimens or more support may still need
admission. Most of the health insurance schemes now provide explicit mention of daycare
chemotherapy.

[

### 6. Will I get a cost estimate before treatment starts?

][31]

Yeah, at Oncare, you have a cost-estimate session before treatment begins, when the staff will
review the likely total cost based on your cancer kind, stage, planned medications, and the number
of cycles. This allows you and your family to plan your budget and receive insurance or help before.

The estimate is a range that’s as accurate as can be because treatment can change based on how your
body reacts. Keep copies of your treatment plan and bills as you go, and ask questions about any
fees that you don’t understand to stay in control of expenses.

[

### 7. What financial help is available if I don’t have insurance?

][32]

If you do not have insurance, several routes can help: subsidised treatment options, NGO and charity
support, and hospital payment plans. A financial counsellor can match these to your situation.

Choosing generic or biosimilar drugs and day-care chemotherapy also lowers out-of-pocket costs
significantly. At Oncare, the team provides cost-estimate sessions and helps families identify every
applicable scheme and assistance programme before treatment begins.

[

### 8. What questions should I ask at my first oncology appointment?

][33]

It helps to ask at your first session: What kind and stage of cancer do I have? What is the purpose
of treatment? What are my alternatives and their harmful effects? How long will treatment take? What
will it cost? Writing things down ahead of time makes the visit much more useful.

Bring a family member or a friend to take notes and urge the doctor to repeat anything you don’t
understand in simpler terms. Also, ask who to contact in between visits and if a second opinion or
biomarker testing is recommended for your situation.

[

### 9. Can I work during cancer treatment?

][34]

Many people can continue working through cancer treatment, but you may need to cut hours or change
duties around treatment days due to exhaustion. It depends on your job, your type of therapy, and
how you feel, so prepare for flexibility rather than assuming you must stop working entirely.

For these reasons, lighter schedules around infusion days are helpful as fatigue commonly builds up
throughout a course of chemotherapy. Be open in talking with your employer about appropriate changes
and with your care team about how to fit in treatments into your routine where possible.

[

### 10. Is surgery required for my cancer treatment?

][35]

Not all cancer treatments involve surgery. Whether you may need surgery depends on the type of
cancer, how far it has progressed, where it is located, and your general state of health. Surgery
can sometimes assist in removing the tumor completely in many early-stage malignancies. Some cancers
respond better to chemotherapy, radiation therapy, immunotherapy, or targeted treatments.

Sometimes surgery is also performed for diagnosis, staging, debulking, or symptom relief. Our
oncology experts take care to assess each patient before suggesting the best course of treatment.

[Anasayfa Ameliyatsiz Bel ve Boyun Fitigi Tedavileri][Anasayfa Ameliyatsiz Bel ve Boyun Fitigi
Tedavileri]

### Ameliyatsız Bel ve
### Boyun Fıtığı Tedavileri

Ozon, radyofrekans veya lazer diskektomi yöntemlerinden kişiye uygun olanseçilerek fıtığın içine
iğne ile girerek küçültücü işlem (farmako termal regresyon) yapılır. Yaklaşık 3 ay içinde fıtık
geriler ve sinir basısı azalır.

[Anasayfa Ameliyatsiz Tiroid Tedavisi][Anasayfa Ameliyatsiz Tiroid Tedavisi]

### Ameliyatsız Tiroid
### Tedavisi

Ciltten girimle (Radyofrekans, Mikrodalga, Kriyoablasyon) nodül yakılarak (ablasyon) ya da çok büyük
guatrlarda ve de Basedow Graves hastalığında embolizasyon yöntemiyle, ameliyatsız olarak 30 dakikada
tedavi sağlanır. Nodüller küçülür ve semptomlar giderilir ve hastalar tiroid ilacı kullanmazlar.

[Anasayfa Kanser Hastaliklari Tedavileri][Anasayfa Kanser Hastaliklari Tedavileri]

### Kanser Hastalıkları
### Tedavileri

Kanser tedavisinde girişimsel radyoloji yöntemleriyle, tümöre doğrudan hedeflenen tedaviler
uygulanabilir. Tümör besleyici damarların tıkandığı kemoembolizasyon, radyofrekans ve mikrodalga
ablasyon gibi yöntemlerle sağlıklı dokular korunarak tedavi gerçekleştirilir. Bu tedaviler,
cerrahiye uygun olmayan veya ek tedaviye ihtiyaç duyan uygun hastalarda güvenle kullanılabilir.

[Anasayfa Erektil Disfonksiyon Tedavisi][Anasayfa Erektil Disfonksiyon Tedavisi]

### Erektil Disfonksiyon
### Tedavisi

Organik sertleşme sorununun çoğunluğunu damarsal sertleşme bozuklukları oluşturur. Genç yaşlarda
çoğunlukla toplardamar kaçakları sebep olur ve embolizasyon yapılabilir. Atar damar kökenli olanlar
ileri yaşlarda ortaya çıkar. Tıkalı damarların balon veya stent ile tedavisi hedeflenir.

[Anasayfa Beyin Damar Hastaliklari Tedavisi][Anasayfa Beyin Damar Hastaliklari Tedavisi]

### Beyin Damar
### Hastalıkları Tedavisi

Beyin damar tıkanıklıkları, anevrizmalar ve damar yumakları gibi hastalıklar, anjiyografik
yöntemlerle uygun hastalarda ameliyatsız olarak tedavi edilebilir. Balon, stent ve coil uygulamaları
sayesinde damar içinden yapılan girişimlerle kan akımı düzenlenir ve beyin dokusu korunur. Erken
tanı ve hızlı müdahale, kalıcı hasar riskini önemli ölçüde azaltır.

[Anasayfa hakkimdagorsel 1][Anasayfa hakkimdagorsel 1]
PROF. DR.
**Özgür KILIÇKESMEZ**
[Anasayfa yazi icon][Anasayfa yazi icon]

Türkiye’nin Girişimsel Radyoloji ve Nöroradyoloji Doktoru

Prof. Dr. Özgür Kılıçkesmez, İstanbul’da ve Türkiye genelinde en iyi Girişimsel Radyoloji ve
Nöroradyoloji doktorlarından biri olma hedefiyle, hem yurt içinden hem de yurt dışından gelen

### Boyun Fıtığı Tedavileri

Ozon, radyofrekans veya lazer diskektomi yöntemlerinden kişiye uygun olanseçilerek fıtığın içine
iğne ile girerek küçültücü işlem (farmako termal regresyon) yapılır. Yaklaşık 3 ay içinde fıtık
geriler ve sinir basısı azalır.

[Anasayfa Ameliyatsiz Tiroid Tedavisi][Anasayfa Ameliyatsiz Tiroid Tedavisi]

### Ameliyatsız Tiroid
### Tedavisi

Ciltten girimle (Radyofrekans, Mikrodalga, Kriyoablasyon) nodül yakılarak (ablasyon) ya da çok büyük
guatrlarda ve de Basedow Graves hastalığında embolizasyon yöntemiyle, ameliyatsız olarak 30 dakikada
tedavi sağlanır. Nodüller küçülür ve semptomlar giderilir ve hastalar tiroid ilacı kullanmazlar.

[Anasayfa Kanser Hastaliklari Tedavileri][Anasayfa Kanser Hastaliklari Tedavileri]

### Kanser Hastalıkları
### Tedavileri

Kanser tedavisinde girişimsel radyoloji yöntemleriyle, tümöre doğrudan hedeflenen tedaviler
uygulanabilir. Tümör besleyici damarların tıkandığı kemoembolizasyon, radyofrekans ve mikrodalga
ablasyon gibi yöntemlerle sağlıklı dokular korunarak tedavi gerçekleştirilir. Bu tedaviler,
cerrahiye uygun olmayan veya ek tedaviye ihtiyaç duyan uygun hastalarda güvenle kullanılabilir.

[Anasayfa Erektil Disfonksiyon Tedavisi][Anasayfa Erektil Disfonksiyon Tedavisi]

### Erektil Disfonksiyon
### Tedavisi

Organik sertleşme sorununun çoğunluğunu damarsal sertleşme bozuklukları oluşturur. Genç yaşlarda
çoğunlukla toplardamar kaçakları sebep olur ve embolizasyon yapılabilir. Atar damar kökenli olanlar
ileri yaşlarda ortaya çıkar. Tıkalı damarların balon veya stent ile tedavisi hedeflenir.

[Anasayfa Beyin Damar Hastaliklari Tedavisi][Anasayfa Beyin Damar Hastaliklari Tedavisi]

### Beyin Damar
### Hastalıkları Tedavisi

Beyin damar tıkanıklıkları, anevrizmalar ve damar yumakları gibi hastalıklar, anjiyografik
yöntemlerle uygun hastalarda ameliyatsız olarak tedavi edilebilir. Balon, stent ve coil uygulamaları
sayesinde damar içinden yapılan girişimlerle kan akımı düzenlenir ve beyin dokusu korunur. Erken
tanı ve hızlı müdahale, kalıcı hasar riskini önemli ölçüde azaltır.

## Tedaviler

Prof. Dr. Özgür Kılıçkesmez, İstanbul’da damar ve organ hastalıklarının tanı ve tedavisinde minimal
invaziv yöntemler uygulayan deneyimli bir girişimsel radyoloji doktorudur. Modern görüntüleme
sistemleri eşliğinde cerrahi gerektirmeyen, güvenli ve etkili tedavi çözümleri sunar.

Girişimsel radyoloji, anjiyo, embolizasyon, biyopsi, tümör ablasyonu, varis ve damar
tıkanıklıklarının tedavisi gibi işlemleri kapsar. Prof. Dr. Özgür Kılıçkesmez, bu işlemleri
ultrason, bilgisayarlı tomografi (BT) ve anjiyografi rehberliğinde yüksek hassasiyetle
gerçekleştirir.

Deneyimli bir girişimsel radyoloji doktoru olarak Prof. Dr. Özgür Kılıçkesmez, karaciğer tümörleri,
rahim miyomları, böbrek ve damar hastalıklarında cerrahiye alternatif minimal invaziv teknikler
uygular. Bu yöntemler, hastada daha az ağrı, daha kısa iyileşme süresi ve düşük komplikasyon riski
sağlar.

Prof. Dr. Özgür Kılıçkesmez, her hastası için kişiye özel tedavi planı oluşturur. Multidisipliner
yaklaşımıyla onkoloji, kalp-damar cerrahisi ve nöroloji uzmanlarıyla iş birliği yaparak en uygun
çözümü sunar. Hedef; etkin, güvenli ve hastaya konfor sağlayan tedavidir.

### Ameliyatsız Bel ve
### Boyun Fıtığı Tedavileri

Ozon, radyofrekans veya lazer diskektomi yöntemlerinden kişiye uygun olanseçilerek fıtığın içine
iğne ile girerek küçültücü işlem (farmako termal regresyon) yapılır. Yaklaşık 3 ay içinde fıtık
geriler ve sinir basısı azalır.

[Anasayfa Ameliyatsiz Tiroid Tedavisi][Anasayfa Ameliyatsiz Tiroid Tedavisi]

### Ameliyatsız Tiroid
### Tedavisi

Ciltten girimle (Radyofrekans, Mikrodalga, Kriyoablasyon) nodül yakılarak (ablasyon) ya da çok büyük
guatrlarda ve de Basedow Graves hastalığında embolizasyon yöntemiyle, ameliyatsız olarak 30 dakikada
tedavi sağlanır. Nodüller küçülür ve semptomlar giderilir ve hastalar tiroid ilacı kullanmazlar.

[Anasayfa Kanser Hastaliklari Tedavileri][Anasayfa Kanser Hastaliklari Tedavileri]

### Kanser Hastalıkları
### Tedavileri

Kanser tedavisinde girişimsel radyoloji yöntemleriyle, tümöre doğrudan hedeflenen tedaviler
uygulanabilir. Tümör besleyici damarların tıkandığı kemoembolizasyon, radyofrekans ve mikrodalga
ablasyon gibi yöntemlerle sağlıklı dokular korunarak tedavi gerçekleştirilir. Bu tedaviler,
cerrahiye uygun olmayan veya ek tedaviye ihtiyaç duyan uygun hastalarda güvenle kullanılabilir.

[Anasayfa Erektil Disfonksiyon Tedavisi][Anasayfa Erektil Disfonksiyon Tedavisi]

### Erektil Disfonksiyon
### Tedavisi

Organik sertleşme sorununun çoğunluğunu damarsal sertleşme bozuklukları oluşturur. Genç yaşlarda
çoğunlukla toplardamar kaçakları sebep olur ve embolizasyon yapılabilir. Atar damar kökenli olanlar
ileri yaşlarda ortaya çıkar. Tıkalı damarların balon veya stent ile tedavisi hedeflenir.

[Anasayfa Beyin Damar Hastaliklari Tedavisi][Anasayfa Beyin Damar Hastaliklari Tedavisi]

### Beyin Damar
### Hastalıkları Tedavisi

Beyin damar tıkanıklıkları, anevrizmalar ve damar yumakları gibi hastalıklar, anjiyografik
yöntemlerle uygun hastalarda ameliyatsız olarak tedavi edilebilir. Balon, stent ve coil uygulamaları
sayesinde damar içinden yapılan girişimlerle kan akımı düzenlenir ve beyin dokusu korunur. Erken
tanı ve hızlı müdahale, kalıcı hasar riskini önemli ölçüde azaltır.

## Tedaviler

Prof. Dr. Özgür Kılıçkesmez, İstanbul’da damar ve organ hastalıklarının tanı ve tedavisinde minimal
invaziv yöntemler uygulayan deneyimli bir girişimsel radyoloji doktorudur. Modern görüntüleme
sistemleri eşliğinde cerrahi gerektirmeyen, güvenli ve etkili tedavi çözümleri sunar.

Girişimsel radyoloji, anjiyo, embolizasyon, biyopsi, tümör ablasyonu, varis ve damar
tıkanıklıklarının tedavisi gibi işlemleri kapsar. Prof. Dr. Özgür Kılıçkesmez, bu işlemleri
ultrason, bilgisayarlı tomografi (BT) ve anjiyografi rehberliğinde yüksek hassasiyetle
gerçekleştirir.

Deneyimli bir girişimsel radyoloji doktoru olarak Prof. Dr. Özgür Kılıçkesmez, karaciğer tümörleri,
rahim miyomları, böbrek ve damar hastalıklarında cerrahiye alternatif minimal invaziv teknikler
uygular. Bu yöntemler, hastada daha az ağrı, daha kısa iyileşme süresi ve düşük komplikasyon riski
sağlar.

Prof. Dr. Özgür Kılıçkesmez, her hastası için kişiye özel tedavi planı oluşturur. Multidisipliner
yaklaşımıyla onkoloji, kalp-damar cerrahisi ve nöroloji uzmanlarıyla iş birliği yaparak en uygun
çözümü sunar. Hedef; etkin, güvenli ve hastaya konfor sağlayan tedavidir.

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

## Supported Robot Brands

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

[ Robot Library][61]
[ 15 more ][62]

## Robot Applications

Use robot arms for any manufacturing application. You can find plenty of examples in our
documentation.

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

## publishing platform done right.

Telescope is a publishing platform with a focus on simplicity, speed, and privacy.

It's like Medium but incredibly fast and with a bunch of SEO optimizations.

[Simple]

### Simple

Powerful and easy-to-use editor with the ability to fully customize links and tags, change the
layout, and include different types of content, be it images, videos, tweets, or code blocks.
[Fast]

### Fast

Our editor is incredibly fast, and the generated blogs and all the inner pages are so lightweight
that they load almost immediately. That's a result of dozens of optimizations you don't have to
maintain or worry about.
[Honest]

### Honest

No ads, no tracking, no hidden scripts, no cookies, nothing! Your content pages contain only the
content and some awesome stylesheets for it, with absolutely nothing else.
[Beautiful]

### Beautiful

Our design is minimal, gorgeous, and fully customizable — as a result, the generated pages are pure,
lightweight, nice, and well-polished, with no weird icons and ads. Ideal for minimalists and
perfectionists!
